text: And Jehovah{H3068} said{H559} unto Moses,{H4872} Go{H935} in unto Pharaoh:{H6547} for I have hardened{H3513} his heart,{H3820} and the heart{H3820} of his servants,{H5650} that I may show{H7896} these my signs{H226} in the midst{H7130} of them,
